description: This file contains functions related to generating and managing prompts for an autocomplete system, including prompt rendering, token counting, and prompt truncation based on token limits.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves an autocomplete template based on the helper's model name.

methods.name: preparePromptContext
methods.description: Prepares the context needed for prompt rendering, including prefix, suffix, reponame, template, snippets, and options.

methods.name: renderPrompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt with optional stop tokens, using the prepared context.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the final prompt by applying prefix/suffix formatting or compilation, then rendering the template.

methods.name: pruneLength
methods.description: Calculates how many tokens need to be pruned from the prompt to fit within the model's context length.

methods.name: renderPromptWithTokenLimit
methods.description: Generates a prompt with token limit enforcement, truncating prefix and suffix as needed.
